QuestInfo.name: Go, Eco Mapleteers!
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has a favor to ask of you...
QuestInfo.1: What does Cassandra want you to do now?
QuestInfo.2: From now on, you will be an Eco Mapleteer for Maple World! Use Cosmic Greens to restore nature to its original beauty.\n\n#bYou can find the Cosmic Green hunting grounds by clicking the Event Notifier located on the left side of your screen.

0.0: #b#h0##k! Perfect timing. Something odd is in the air, don't you think? Something...stinky. The monsters of the world are numbering too many, and the toxic gases they produce are starting to hurt the environment.\n\nI've come up with a plan to appoint some #rEco Mapleteers#k, guardians of nature! Are you interested in helping, #b#h0##k?

no.0: Remember that Maple World needs your power now, #b#h0##k! If you're going to help, do it now!

yes.0:
Excellent! Okay, you're an official Eco Mapleteer! Time to become a new kind of legend in Maple World.

I've given you the #bCosmic Green#k and the #bEco Strategy Journal#k. #rWith the Cosmic Green in your Set-up inventory, attack monsters in certain areas to charge the gauge.#k Once the gauge is full, you can call on the green stars of the universe to unleash the power of #bGoing Green#k. This power will allow you to eliminate hordes of monsters, especially the foul #rDust King#k.

You can find the #bCosmic Green hunting grounds#k through the #r#k by clicking the #i03994375##bEvent Notifier#k on the left side of your screen.

default.0: Make sure you're over Level 10, and have empty slots in your Equip, ETC, Use, and Set-up Inventory tabs.
